verdict.rationale: Factory documents plan-first workflows (Missions define features/milestones/success criteria before code is written; Droid analyzes codebase and shows proposed changes before applying them) and supports diff review/approval via tiered autonomy and inline comments before merge. However, evidence doesn't clearly show a dedicated 'approve plan before any execution' gate distinct from diff review — approvals seem tied to autonomy tiers and command execution rather than a formal plan-approval step. missing for 10: explicit plan-approval UI/step separate from diff/code review, independent/hands-on confirmation that plans are blocked pending human sign-off, and detail on how tiered autonomy pauses specifically at the planning stage.
